Let $\omega$, $\varepsilon$ be real and $\eta>0$. Rationalizing the retarded propagator (the advanced one follows by conjugation),
\begin{align}
\frac{1}{\omega-\varepsilon+i\eta} &= \frac{\omega-\varepsilon-i\eta}{(\omega-\varepsilon)^2+\eta^2}, \qquad
\frac{1}{\omega-\varepsilon-i\eta} = \frac{\omega-\varepsilon+i\eta}{(\omega-\varepsilon)^2+\eta^2} \nonumber\\
&= \frac{\omega-\varepsilon}{(\omega-\varepsilon)^2+\eta^2} - \frac{i\eta}{(\omega-\varepsilon)^2+\eta^2} .
\label{eq:rat}
\end{align}
